summary: Iteration 15: Full E2E testing of Auto Campaign Banner & Slider feature (backend + frontend). Created a new live campaign 'TEST_UIBanner' (Non-Trade, ₹300, TestCo) without banner_url and validated the full lifecycle: auto banner appears in GET /api/banners for customer with all expected fields; PUT to campaign refreshes title/subtitle; pause / offer_enabled=false / archive remove it; PATCH /api/admin/campaigns/{cid}/slider correctly toggles show_in_slider, updates banner_headline/banner_tagline, respects slider_order; non-admin gets 403; empty body returns 400; admin GET /api/banners?all=true returns {manual, auto} incl. hidden autos with enabled:false. Frontend: customer dashboard slider on mobile 390x844 renders GeneratedSlide with LIVE badge, type chip 'Non-Trade', title, company, customer benefit, facts chips (Payout ₹300, Fund: ₹1000, Complete KYC, Easy account opening, Approved TestCo partner) and 'Tap to apply'; link href = /api/go/test-uibanner?ref=RTA12499. Admin /admin/banners banners-auto-section: toggle hides row (state text 'Hidden from slider'), edit → headline/tagline → save updates row title, up/down reorder swaps positions, 'Campaign' link routes to /admin/campaigns?edit=<cid> and opens the campaign edit form, manual banner add form still present (regression OK). All 10 pytest tests + all UI checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2167 lines — should be split into routers by feature (campaigns, banners, wallet, KYC) for maintainability. Currently violates the <700 lines guideline.

GET /api/banners returns different shapes (list vs {manual, auto}) based on admin all=true — consider a dedicated /api/admin/banners endpoint to keep response types stable and reduce client-side branching.
